title: SG-4.2 · Serve the current round at /round/current
summary: Serve the current round at GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current instead of /rounds/current
description: Context: backend/internal/server/server.go:46 registers GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/rounds/current, but the spec path is /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current. Desired behavior: the server serves the current round at the spec path and a routing test uses that path. Expected result: the specified path returns the current round and the old plural path is no longer routed. Why: API consumers must match the documented contract.
acceptance_criteria: Given a world and a round on disk, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current is requested, then the response is 200 with the round JSON
Given the same data, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/current is requested, then the response is 404
A routing test in the server package requests the specified path

in_scope: Change the route path in backend/internal/server/server.go
Add a routing test using the specified path
out_of_scope: Changing the CurrentRound handler or repository logic

technical_constraints: Go with Chi router; no database
